local_review.scope: Local review provenance only; no local intake file is required on the server.

limits: Exactly 18 new uninstrumented M65 Sign cases: batches 256/512/1024 x three E02a seeds x messages 0/32 with empty context.
Only the pinned isolated CTA candidate module/test is executed; no build, source edit, production adoption, or previous pointer/result change.
All SANITIZER_MODE variables are absent; LOCE_H008_DUMP_DIR retains saved-byte evidence. No Compute Sanitizer process is launched.
Both host and device T12 are required; host two_streams_scope=enforced follows real uninstrumented E02a output.
PQMagic SHAKE remains the sole oracle; official KAT and independent PQClean are NOT_RUN.
WPHC audit/closure NOT_AVAILABLE records remain NOT_AVAILABLE and never count as audit PASS.
The mixed 48-case sanitizer matrix is immutable prerequisite evidence; the original-module finding remains UNRESOLVED_IN_ORIGINAL_MODULE.
Only candidate expanded adapter correctness is qualified; full E02, boundary drivers, sampler exhaustion, Engine qualification and formal performance remain separate.
One process per case, fail-fast, no case retries; only GPU_BUSY prechecks wait under the pinned idle policy.
All application timings are diagnostic only, not formal performance data.
When executed from stdin, script bytes are not independently retained or rehashed on the server.
